message.content: {"verdict":"PAY","cited_clauses":[1,2,3,4,5,6,7],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice bills the agreed 300 USDC day rate for QA testing work, within the contractor’s stated scope.","evidence_quote":"Test automation suite                        5 days × 300.00 = 1,500.00"},{"clause":2,"finding":"The 10 billed days are within the monthly cap of 12 days.","evidence_quote":"Days billed: 10, within the 12-day monthly cap."},{"clause":3,"finding":"There are no expense lines requiring written approval.","evidence_quote":"No expense or fee lines."},{"clause":4,"finding":"The invoice’s payment wallet matches the wallet on file, and no payment change was requested.","evidence_quote":"Wallet on the invoice matches the wallet on file."},{"clause":5,"finding":"No other invoice covers this invoice number or period.","evidence_quote":"No other invoice on file covers this invoice number or period."},{"clause":6,"finding":"The invoice was received 5 days after the billing period ended, within 60 days.","evidence_quote":"Received 2026-09-05, 5 days after the billing period ended (2026-08-31)."},{"clause":7,"finding":"Test automation is within the contractor’s QA testing scope, so no out-of-scope sign-off is required.","evidence_quote":"Scope of work: Manual and automated QA testing of web and mobile releases."}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
